name: הוֹדַוְיָה
summary: Chronicles names a son of Elioenai, a Manassite leader and a Benjaminite ancestor. Ezra names a Levitical house. The opening of the name resembles the call to give thanks, followed by the short form of Yahweh’s name.
note: The proposed reading rests on the form. Scripture does not give an explanation of the name.
